CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 23
   C. 30
   D. 120

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 38

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

9. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
